tools.name: email-domain_syntax-validate
tools.description: Check that an address is a bare email with a public domain. The mailbox is not contacted, and a valid result does not mean the address exists. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/email-domain/syntax-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: email-domain_verify
tools.description: Resolve a public domain and report whether nameserver, address, and MX records were found. MX presence does not mean a mailbox exists. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/email-domain/verify. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: email-domain_mx-record-check
tools.description: Look up MX hosts, including a null MX, and resolve each public host. Missing records, lookup failures, and non-public hosts are reported separately. No message is sent. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/email-domain/mx-record-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: email-domain_spf-record-analyze
tools.description: Read the published SPF policy and expand redirect or include targets for one level, up to eight lookups. +all is reported as a misconfiguration. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/email-domain/spf-record-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: email-domain_dkim-record-check
tools.description: Look up DKIM public keys for the supplied selectors. When no selector is supplied, only google, selector1, selector2, s1, s2, and k1 are queried. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/email-domain/dkim-record-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: email-domain_dmarc-policy-analyze
tools.description: Read the _dmarc TXT record and report p and pct. A missing record, a failed lookup, and p=none are separate results. No aggregate report is sent. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/email-domain/dmarc-policy-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: email-domain_reputation-signals
tools.description: Return the RDAP registration date and whether a DNSSEC DS record is published. The reputation verdict stays unavailable because no unauthenticated reputation feed is queried. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/email-domain/reputation-signals. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not ru

tools.name: email-domain_registration-lookup
tools.description: Read public RDAP data for the domain, including registrar, registration and expiration events, status, and nameservers. A not-found response is not proof the domain is unregistered everywhere. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/email-domain/registration-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment te

tools.name: email-domain_tls-inspect
tools.description: Connect to port 443 of a public address for the domain and read the certificate. Certificate transparency names come from public crt.sh results. No other port is contacted. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/email-domain/tls-inspect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: email-domain_deliverability-report
tools.description: Combine syntax, MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, RDAP, and TLS checks. No message is sent, the mailbox is not checked, and a clear report does not promise delivery. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/email-domain/deliverability-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "email-domain" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email-domain_syntax-validate, email-domain_mx-record-check, email-domain_spf-record-analyze, email-domain_dkim-record-check, email-domain_dmarc-policy-analyze, email-domain_registration-lookup, email-domain_tls-inspect · Private data: email-domain_verify, email-domain_mx-record-check, email-domain_spf-record-analyze, email-domain_dkim-record-check, email-domain_dmarc-policy-analyze, email-domain_reputation-signals · Public sink: email-domain_syntax-validate, email-domain_verify, email-domain_mx-record-check, email-domain_spf-record-analyze, email-domain_dkim-record-check, email-domain_dmarc-policy-analyze, email-domain_reputation-signals, email-domain_registration-lookup, email-domain_tls-inspect, email-domain_deliverability-report · Destructive: email-domain_syntax-validate, email-domain_verify, email-domain_mx-record-check, email-domain_spf-record-analyze, email-domain_dkim-record-check, email-domain_dmarc-policy-analyze, email-domain_reputation-signals, email-domain_registration-lookup, email-domain_tls-inspect, email-domain_deliverability-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
